lead: Things kept to decorate a home and garden — decorative glass and ceramics, mirrors and wall decor, candles and home fragrance, seasonal and folk decorations, party effects and fireworks, artificial plants, garden ornaments and flags — organised by kind, with named makers, houses and craft traditions where people collect.

depts.note: Tier for everyday vases; variety for art glass and ceramic traditions.

b.v: mass-made; studio; named house or tradition
b.w: Collectors and dealers sort decorative glass and ceramics by house and tradition first.
Signatures, factory marks and labels decide attribution and value.
Everyday buyers choose for the place and the flowers.
Chips, cracks and restoration are judged on each piece.

s.brief: Add archetypes with sources: Fazzoletto handkerchief vase (Venini, 1949), Aalto/Savoy vase (Iittala, 1936), Lalique Bacchantes vase, Orrefors Graal/Ariel pieces, Moser cut vases, Delft tulipière (tulip vase as a version of Vase or archetype), Iznik-style vessels, Meissen vases, blue-and-white ginger jar, Bohemian cut-glass. Link craft traditions (Murano glass, Bohemian glass/Moser, Lalique/French art glass, Swedish art glass/Orrefors–Kosta, Delftware, Iznik pottery, Meissen porcelain) via the traditions register and make the brand register entries for Venini, Iittala, Lalique, Orrefors, Kosta Boda, Moser, Royal Delft, Meissen, Baccarat. Trim the Lenox SKU models to versions of archetypes or drop. Wall vase becomes a type of Vase. Add Glass paperweight (Baccarat, Saint-Louis, Clichy millefiori; Caithness; Perthshire).

k.brief: Wall vase becomes a type; archetypes Fazzoletto, Aalto, Bacchantes, tulipière etc.
New: millefiori and lampwork paperweights; Baccarat, Saint-Louis, Clichy, Caithness.

depts.note: Tier for everyday mirrors and frames; design icons for mirrors.

b.m: Fit to the space and where it hangs
b.w: Mirrors and wall pieces are chosen for the place first.
Distortion is the first quality fault.
Backing keeps the silvering from failing.
Secure fixing for the size.

s.brief: Keep a few market-covering models (IKEA etc.) and add design archetypes with sources: Ultrafragola (Ettore Sottsass, Poltronova, 1970), sunburst mirror (Line Vautrin / Chaty Vallauris), Venetian mirror, convex/girandole mirror, cheval mirror, overmantel mirror. Floor mirror keeps types leaner/cheval.
Pure restraint: keep kind-level definitions, no models.

depts.note: Tier for everyday candles; variety for fragrance houses and incense traditions. Houses link to the Fragrance (H4) brand register.

b.w: Throw leads candle tests.
Burn quality follows throw.
Home fragrance is chosen by scent and house.
Hours per candle; weeks per diffuser.

s.brief: Add home-fragrance candle houses as archetypes/register entries: Diptyque (Baies, Feu de Bois), Cire Trudon (Abd El Kader, Ernesto), Byredo, Jo Malone London, Le Labo (Santal 26), Yankee Candle, Bath & Body Works 3-wick, Voluspa, Cereria Mollá, Neom; brands go to the brand register (link H4 Fragrance). Keep IKEA basics as models only where useful. Candle holder keeps types candlestick/tealight holder; add design-icon holders if well sourced (e.g. Nagel candleholder, Kubus by Mogens Lassen/by Lassen).

Restraint plus houses: reed diffusers from the same houses (Diptyque, Jo Malone, Byredo), electric diffusers (types ultrasonic, nebulising, plug-in). Add new kind Catalytic fragrance lamp (Lampe Berger, 1898). Keep potpourri and sachet kind-level.

Organise by tradition: Japanese kōdō/senkō (Shoyeido, Baieido, Nippon Kodo, Kyukyodo, Kunmeido), bakhoor and oud (Arabian Oud, Ajmal, Swiss Arabian; oud chips, mamoul), Tibetan (Mindroling, Holy Land), Indian agarbatti/masala and dhoop (Satya Nag Champa, Hem, Shroff). Add craft-tradition entries for kōdō, bakhoor/oud, Tibetan incense, Indian incense. Nippon Kodo ranges become archetypes/versions. Loose incense keeps types (bakhoor, oud chips, resin, powder). Add Mabkhara (incense burner for bakhoor) and Kōdō utensil set (kōdōgu, incense heater with mica plate) as new kinds; incense burner keeps types holder, censer, backflow burner.

depts.note: Tier for everyday decorations; variety for collectible ornaments and folk crafts.

b.w: Collectible ornaments are chosen by maker, series and era.
Folk crafts are judged by region and workshop (Erzgebirge, Lauscha, Naruko, Nusnäs).
Artificial tree tests rank realism, fullness and lights.

s.brief: Collectible ornament makers and lines: Lauscha blown glass (tradition entry), Christopher Radko, Old World Christmas, Inge-Glas, Kurt Adler, Hallmark Keepsake Ornaments, Käthe Wohlfahrt. Artificial trees: market brands plus test winners (Balsam Hill, National Tree Company). Add new kind Christmas village (Department 56 Snow Village/Dickens' Village, Lemax). Trim SKU lists.

Folk and seasonal crafts as kinds with archetypes and traditions: Erzgebirge woodcraft (nutcracker — Steinbach, Christian Ulbricht, Wendt & Kühn for figures; smoking man/Räuchermann; Christmas pyramid; Schwibbogen candle arch), kokeshi (Naruko, Tōgatta, sōsaku kokeshi), Dala horse (Nils Olsson Hemslöjd, Grannas A. Olsson), matryoshka (Sergiev Posad, Semyonov, Polkhovsky Maidan), daruma, hina dolls (festival doll display: hina-ningyō, gogatsu-ningyō; keep makers as versions), kadomatsu entrance decoration, snow globe (Erwin Perzy, Vienna, originator). Add tradition entries: Erzgebirge woodcraft, kokeshi, Dalecarlian horse, matryoshka, Lauscha glass (shared with Christmas), hina-ningyō.

Mostly restraint. Merge fog and haze machines into one kind with types fog, haze, low-fog; keep a few consumer/prosumer models (Antari, ADJ, Chauvet DJ, Eliminator, Hazebase) and drop trade-only units. Add new kinds Balloon (latex, foil, types) and Piñata (Mexican tradition).

Organise consumer fireworks by effect type (kind = device; effect types such as peony, chrysanthemum, willow, palm, crossette, crackling, strobe as `t` or archetypes). Dissolve 'Other fireworks' into the right kinds (its Brothers/Evo/Primed/Pyroworx items are mostly cakes). Note classes (EU F1–F4 / UK categories, US 1.4G) in brief. Makers: Brothers Pyrotechnics, Standard Fireworks, Black Cat, Epic Fireworks, Cobra, Weco, Zena. New kinds: Firecracker, Aerial shell (consumer mortar), Mine, Ground spinner, Smoke device.

b.w: Artificial plants are judged on how real they look and feel.
Outdoor pieces must hold colour.

b.v: resin; concrete/reconstituted stone; cast iron; bronze; carved stone
b.w: Outdoor ornaments are chosen by material and how it weathers.

b.v: tuned; untuned (the scale is a detail of each chime)
b.w: Wind chimes split on tuning.

s.brief: Garden gnome: Philipp Griebel/Gräfenroda origin, Zeho, Heissner (tradition/archetype). Garden statue archetypes: classical copies (Haddonstone, Chilstone reconstituted stone). Add Bird bath and Garden sundial (decorative) as new kinds. Gazing ball tradition (Venetian/German 'Gazing globe').

Wind chimes: tuned makers Woodstock Chimes, Music of the Spheres, Koshi chimes, Zaphir; Japanese furin (Nambu tekki iron, Edo glass) as a tradition; trim the Flamboya SKU list. Weathervanes: copper/cast archetypes (cockerel, banner). Water features kind-level.

b.w: Flags are chosen by material grade.
Follows material.

s.brief: Collapse national, state/territory, garden and house flags into one Flag kind with types; keep pennant, feather banner, windsock, flagpole kind-level.

k.brief: Types: national, state or territory, house, garden.

s.brief: Merge wall and hanging signs into one Sign kind with types; keep illuminated sign kind-level.
